dct_description_sm: authore Ioanne Griguigero ; Ioannes à Deutecũ Lucas à Deutecũ fecerunt.
2 bar scales on map, given in “Mil. Ger. Mag.” and “Mil. Ger. Par.”
From de Jode's Speculum Orbis Terrarum, Part II, Plate VIII, Antwerp, 1578.
This copy has pencil inscriptions in lower left: 433; and lower right: De Jode 1578.
Latin text on verso: Bohemiae Regnum ...
